title: Targeted conjugates and particles and formulations thereof
abstract: Nanoparticles and microparticles containing conjugates of therapeutic, prophylactic or diagnostic agents attached to active agents such as targeting moieties such as somatostatin receptor binding moieties via linkers, and pharmaceutical formulations thereof. Such nanoparticles and microparticles can provide improved time-space delivery of active agents and / or improved biodistribution. Methods of making the conjugates, the particles, and formulations thereof are provided. Methods of administering the formulations to a subject in need thereof are provided for treating or preventing cancer or infectious diseases, for example.
